'''Nacelle Kayama''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]] and also secretly a member of the [[Black Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nacelle Kayama}}

== Appearance and Personality ==
She was tall and slender and had blue eyes.

Romanda thinks that she is not particularly intelligent.

==Strength and Abilities==
Nacelle has a [[One Power]] strength of {{opsl|42}}, which is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] for an Aes Sedai. 

She has some ability in reading residues and developed a [[weave]] that detects the use of ''[[saidin]]''.

==History==
She was born in {{ne|855}} in [[Malkier]]. 

==Activities==
After the split in the White Tower, she joined [[Rebel Aes Sedai]].

Because of her ability to read residues, she was one of the six sisters sent from the rebel camp to investigate the [[channeling]] near [[Shadar Logoth]] after the [[cleansing of saidin|cleansing of ''saidin'']].

In [[Verin Mathwin]]'s book given to [[Egwene al'Vere]], Nacelle is listed as a member of the Black Ajah. It can be assumed she was one of the fifty Black sisters executed in the rebel camp.

==Trivia==
She is the only Malkieri Aes Sedai mentioned in the series.
